overview: 62 new pieces in the last 48 hours across 13 sources. Most of it is about software engineering, AI tools, AI research.

reads.title: [AINews] The No AI Slop Manifesto
reads.author: swyx .ai
reads.description: November 13, 2026 — AIE speakers unite to lay out how to fight slop.
reads.summary: Congrats to both llama.ccp and ggml for reaching 1.0 (declaring stability and removing 35 deprecated functions from llama.cpp’s public header) and with SGLang also announcing 1.0 at the recent SGLang Summit . However, today’s title story goes to the No AI Slop manifesto , which arose out of the conference discussions at AIE CODE and which Dex introduced in the closing keynote after cosignatures by many of the speaker

reads.title: [AINews] Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years leading NVIDIA
reads.author: swyx .ai
reads.description: November 12, 2026 — Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO. What happens to open source/American AI leadership?
reads.summary: Congrats to Gemini 4 Hydrogen on their launch and it seems Anthropic’s IPO is well under way, but today’s headline was only ever going to be about one thing, the most earthshaking leadership change in AI (after Demis/Jeff/et al at Google DeepMind). Yesterday we covered reports that NVIDIA’s board was preparing to replace Jensen Huang following an NYT report of an affair with an accused Chinese spy .

reads.title: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
reads.author: Allison
reads.description: You can now turn GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for repositories on or off with the REST API at the organization and repository levels. This public preview adds a repository_scan… The post Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
reads.summary: You can now turn GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for repositories on or off with the REST API at the organization and repository levels. This public preview adds a repository_scan setting to the existing AI Scan enablement endpoints.

reads.title: GitHub availability report: October 2026
reads.author: Jakub Oleksy
reads.description: In October, we experienced eight incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services. The post GitHub availability report: October 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
reads.summary: We continue to share monthly updates on the work behind GitHub’s availability and reliability. The short version of October: we added substantial independently scalable Azure capacity and removed several ways that failures could escalate.

reads.title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #319: Mentoring Developers Beyond the Code With Tim Schilling
reads.description: What's it take to be a mentor to developers? Where in an engineer's career can a mentor make an impact? This week we speak with Tim Schilling, Django Steering Council member and Djangonaut Space administrator, about mentoring Python developers.
reads.summary: What's it take to be a mentor to developers? Where in an engineer's career can a mentor make an impact?

developments.title: AI Ambition: ArtCraft Cloned Photoshop and Now Wants to "Rebuild Everything"
developments.author: Richard MacManus
developments.description: ArtCraft used AI to rewrite Photoshop as open source software. For CEO Brandon Thomas, the vision is even bigger: to take back the internet!
developments.summary: The theme of day two of the AI Engineer Code Summit in San Francisco was increasing ambition using AI . And there have been few projects as ambitious as ArtCraft in the AI era.
